sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 440 x 500 x 186 mm (w x d x h) (sources disagree on a dimension); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Sound On Sound review read by a research pass 2026-11-12 (the plan sources are a dimensions PDF and a dealer page): rear 16 XLR mic and 16 TRS line inputs, two stereo TRS inputs, 12 XLR outputs (main L / R and ten mixes), an AES3 stereo digital output, one USB-B streaming port, one Cat5 snake port and one Ethernet network port, a talkback input; the mains connection is not stated. Axis order and a depth conflict mean the plan size is an estimate (440 x 500 x 186 mm), so beta-modelled; modelled subset of 10 ports. The sloped profile is an estimate. Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened.
